newsitem.title: USA: Andersons says expects loss in Q3.
newsitem.headline: Andersons says expects loss in Q3.

text.p: Andersons Inc, a regional grain merchandiser, said Tuesday that it expects to record a loss in the third quarter due to seasonal factors.

"The July through September period is normally a loss period for the Andersons, and we expect this year's third quarter to be somewhat typical," said Mike Anderson, the company's president and chief operating officer.
Anderson said that the second quarter had been "good" but because of a "tough" first quarter, the company was still behind 1996 year-to-date. He added, "The grain business will

continue to struggle throughout the first nine months of 1997 because we simply have fewer bushels available in our region until the upcoming harvest. At the moment, the crops look good, so we're optomistic about a better harvest in our territory this year."
The company reported second quarter earnings of $0.52 a share, or $4.2 million, compared with $0.16 a share, or $1.3 million during the same time last year.
In late Nasdaq trading the stock was up 1/4 at 8-1/4.
